source_name: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series — OS Command Injection Defense
source_recommendation_assessment: OWASP recommends avoiding direct OS command execution when possible. Where execution is necessary, the defence includes separating arguments from shell syntax and validating values against an allow-list.
